architecture: v2 (re-rooted 2026-10-18 after architecture 1's stage-4 reader landed the call)
niche: a fishing producer organisation choosing the one ground its members close for the 2027 season by how far each ground's haddock stock has fallen since its 2019 to 2021 base, readable from the members' tow logbooks or from the organisation's fixed-station autumn survey
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every logbook field and the plan correctly standardises the members' catch per hour towed by year, cell, vessel and month, the field's own commercial index, and closes the ground whose catch rate fell furthest, while on the ground whose stock fell furthest the rate holds because the boats followed the shrinking stock into the deep cells it still fills; the fixed-station survey, each depth stratum weighted by its share of the ground's stock area, closes that ground instead.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a population mean over a whole area estimated from a sample whose locations the collectors choose by what they find there (preferential sampling) set against a probability sample of the same area; replacing the probability-sample estimator with the generic summary of the records (catch per unit of effort, raw or standardised) changes the call, and in another field's nouns there is no collector that follows the quantity it measures, so the task stops reading the same.
layer1: the members' logbooks change from paper trip forms (2019 to 2022, one line per trip and rectangle) to electronic tow records (2023 on, one line per tow)
catch on the paper forms in round weight, on the e-logbook in gutted weight with the conversion factor printed on the form
effort on paper as hours fished, on the e-logbook as haul start and end times in UTC
grid cells written as ICES-style rectangle plus sub-square on paper and as a single cell code on the e-logbook
survey stations moved within their stratum after net damage, a missed station in 2020 for weather
a vessel's registration changed in 2024 (new port letters, same hull) across the logbooks and the vessel list
stakeholder_role: the producer organisation's science and sustainability officer, who puts the 2027 closure to the management committee

spine.entity: one tow (one paper trip's fishing in one cell before 2023) with its effort and haddock catch
spine.grain: vessel x tow (vessel x trip x cell before 2023)

world.geography: United Kingdom, Scottish waters (the producer organisation, its grounds and its people are fictional; personas on the en_GB index)

driver: The decisive quantity is how far each area's stock has fallen, observable either through the records of collectors who choose where to sample by how much they find there or through a fixed probability sample of the whole area; as a stock shrinks it retreats into the best part of its area and the collectors follow it, so their catch per unit of effort holds up while the stock falls and the parts they abandon drop out of their record, and only the fixed sample, weighted over the whole area, shows the fall.
driver_concrete: Each ground's haddock stock in 2026 against its 2019 to 2021 average, read from the organisation's autumn survey (fixed stations in depth strata, each stratum weighted by its share of the ground's stock area), not from the members' catch per hour towed, which holds up on the ground whose stock retreated into its deep core because the boats followed it there and stopped working the shallow cells.
stump: A competent solver standardises the members' catch per hour towed by year, cell, vessel and month and closes the ground whose catch rate fell furthest; the step that lands it there is reading each stock from where the fleet chose to fish, which on the ground whose stock fell furthest stayed in the deep cells the shrinking stock still fills, while the survey's stations in the abandoned shallows show the stock gone.

differentiation.task199: task199 reads a rise in event frequency against the volume of accounts its watchers filed, effort measures the events themselves produce; task268 v2 reads a stock's fall from a fixed probability sample of the whole stock area because the commercial effort moved into the cells the shrinking stock still fills, a spatial selection with no event-produced effort measure
differentiation.task196: task196 recovers an uncounted total from two capture channels whose second is produced by follow-up on the first; task268 v2 has one preferentially located record and one probability sample of the same area, no capture overlap and no total to recover, only a change read where the record stopped covering the stock
differentiation.task255: task255 fits a size distribution's upper tail through item floors as truncation and a moving ceiling as censoring; task268 v2 has no size distribution, no truncation and no censoring, only an area mean whose record covers the cells the collectors chose
differentiation.task456: task456 counts a latent state from three error-prone records with a latent class model; task268 v2 has no misclassification and no latent class, a probability sample against a record located by what the collectors find
differentiation.task462: task462 corrects intermittent sources' detections by a size-dependent detection probability measured on blind trials; task268 v2 has no detection model, the survey's tows catch what is there and the record's bias is where the boats chose to tow

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many people are at each small area on a typical day, known completely only as the members attached to each area and observed day by day only in a broad sample whose on-site rate falls with how far a member lives from the area; carrying the sample's rate for each kind of member onto the complete attachments credits the areas that draw their members from far away with too many present, so the rate has to be carried within the groups it varies across.
lineage.architecture: v1 (a quick-commerce grocer's 2027 weekday dark-store pilot among six metros, by each core's delivery-weighted density of people present, the commuting table's flows carried at a national survey's days on the premises)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-18 at stage 4: the isolated reader carried the survey's share by industry group and HOMEREL onto every flow by reflex and committed the golden call, Tessavon at 28,805 against Corrisford's 21,709 (score_reader.py exit 1); the stratum was a classifier both sources share, so the careful analyst's first group-by; the judge found the call forced, Gate H passing, and two ask forks

notes: Re-rooted 2026-10-18: the seed DA18's world (siting by weekday presence) offers no lever beyond carrying a survey rate within strata both sources share, which the stage-4 reader took by reflex; architecture 2 is a new world drawn from the escape the record names, a forcing input in a different file at a different grain (the fixed-station survey over the whole stock area) whose variety no stratification of the decision file (the logbooks) reproduces. stump_strategy population_selection: the record's population of cells is selected on the outcome (the boats go where the fish are). Personas drawn with guard.py names --geo 'United Kingdom' --seed 268. WARNs answered: repeat.gate_g and overuse.gate_g (method_or_model_selection): the decisive step chooses the estimator of each stock (the probability sample over the whole area against the record the fleet's choices located), a method choice no other mechanism describes; the batch varies elsewhere (general statistics in a fisheries setting, a member body, a committee, shape 01, a where question, a pptx deck).
